questions.question: DOCTOR : PATIENT :: LAWYER : ___
questions.explanation: A doctor provides professional services to a patient. Similarly, a lawyer provides professional services to a client. The relationship is professional service provider : recipient.

questions.question: BOOK : LIBRARY :: PAINTING : ___
questions.explanation: A book is kept in a library; a painting is kept in a museum. The relationship is object : place where it is housed.

questions.question: FISH : SCHOOL :: WOLF : ___
questions.explanation: A group of fish is called a school. A group of wolves is called a pack. The relationship is animal : collective noun for that animal's group.

questions.question: All managers are leaders. Some leaders are visionaries. Which conclusion is valid?
questions.explanation: Since all managers are leaders and some leaders are visionaries, it follows that some managers (those who are also visionaries) may be visionaries. We cannot conclude ALL managers are visionaries.

questions.question: SCALPEL : SURGEON :: GAVEL : ___
questions.explanation: A scalpel is the primary tool of a surgeon. A gavel (the small mallet) is the primary tool of a judge to maintain order in the courtroom.

questions.question: If all honest people are trustworthy, and Juan is honest, what can be concluded?
questions.explanation: This is a valid deductive argument (modus ponens): All P are Q; X is P; therefore X is Q. All honest people are trustworthy; Juan is honest; therefore Juan is trustworthy.

questions.question: POEM : ANTHOLOGY :: SONG : ___
questions.explanation: An anthology is a collection of poems. An album is a collection of songs. The relationship is individual work : collection of that type of work.

questions.question:
Study the table and answer:

Employee | Days Worked | Daily Rate
Anna     |     20      |   ₱500
Ben      |     15      |   ₱600
Carla    |     22      |   ₱450

Who earned the most?
If no corrupt officials are honest, and some officials are corrupt, which statement must be true?
questions.explanation: Since some officials are corrupt and no corrupt officials are honest, those corrupt officials are not honest. Therefore, some officials (the corrupt ones) are not honest.

questions.question: FEVER : ILLNESS :: WAR : ___
questions.explanation: Fever is a symptom or consequence of illness. Destruction is a consequence of war. The relationship is symptom/consequence : cause.

questions.question:
Study the pattern and find the missing value:
2, 4, 3, 9, 4, 16, 5, ___
questions.explanation: The pattern alternates: number, then its square. 2, 2²=4, 3, 3²=9, 4, 4²=16, 5, 5²=25.

questions.question: DEMOCRACY : VOTE :: AUTOCRACY : ___
questions.explanation: In a democracy, decisions are made by vote (the will of the majority). In an autocracy, decisions are made by decree (the will of the single ruler). The relationship is system of government : how decisions are made.

questions.question:
Premise 1: All employees who are punctual receive a bonus.
Premise 2: Maria does not receive a bonus.
Conclusion: ?
choices: Maria did not apply for a bonus.
questions.explanation: This uses the contrapositive (modus tollens): If P then Q; not Q; therefore not P. All punctual employees get bonuses; Maria has no bonus; therefore Maria is not punctual.

questions.question: EVAPORATION : WATER CYCLE :: PHOTOSYNTHESIS : ___
questions.explanation: Evaporation is a key process in the water cycle. Photosynthesis (which converts CO₂ into organic compounds) is a key process in the carbon cycle.

questions.question:
Which figure completes the pattern?

Row 1: ■ ■ □
Row 2: ■ □ ■
Row 3: □ ■ ___
questions.explanation: In each row, there are two filled squares (■) and one empty square (□). In Row 3, the □ and ■ are placed in positions 1 and 2, so position 3 must be ■ to maintain the pattern of two ■ per row.

questions.question:
Based on the data:
City A: 1,200 cases
City B: 850 cases
City C: 1,050 cases
City D: 720 cases

Which cities have MORE than the average number of cases?
ILLITERATE : READ :: DEAF : ___
questions.explanation: An illiterate person cannot read. A deaf person cannot hear. The relationship is condition : inability associated with that condition.

questions.question:
All birds have wings. A bat has wings. Therefore, a bat is a bird.

This argument is:
choices: Invalid — the conclusion does not follow from the premises
questions.answer: Invalid — the conclusion does not follow from the premises
questions.explanation: This is the fallacy of affirming the consequent. Just because bats have wings (like birds) does not make them birds. Having wings is not a sufficient condition for being a bird.

questions.question: THERMOMETER : TEMPERATURE :: BAROMETER : ___
questions.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature. A barometer measures atmospheric pressure. The relationship is instrument : what it measures.

questions.question:
Study the table: 

Year | Revenue (₱M)
2020 | 10
2021 | 14
2022 | 19
2023 | 25
2024 | ?

If the pattern continues, what is the 2024 revenue?
questions.explanation: Differences: 4, 5, 6 — increasing by 1 each year. Next difference = 7. 2024 revenue = 25 + 7 = ₱32M.

questions.question: CRIME : PUNISHMENT :: CAUSE : ___
questions.explanation: A crime leads to a punishment. A cause leads to an effect. The relationship is initiating event : resulting event.

questions.question: If it rains, the game is cancelled. The game was not cancelled. What can we conclude?
questions.explanation: This is modus tollens: If P then Q; not Q; therefore not P. If it rains (P) then game cancelled (Q). Game not cancelled (not Q). Therefore, it did not rain (not P).

questions.question: CATERPILLAR : BUTTERFLY :: TADPOLE : ___
questions.explanation: A caterpillar transforms into a butterfly through metamorphosis. A tadpole transforms into a frog through metamorphosis. The relationship is larval form : adult form.

questions.question: Based on the chart, if 40% of 500 employees work in Finance and 30% in HR, how many employees work in OTHER departments?
questions.explanation: Finance: 40% of 500 = 200. HR: 30% of 500 = 150. Total in Finance + HR = 350. Other departments = 500 − 350 = 150.

questions.question: IGNORANCE : KNOWLEDGE :: POVERTY : ___
questions.explanation: Ignorance is the absence or opposite of knowledge. Poverty is the absence or opposite of wealth. The relationship is state : its direct opposite.

questions.question:
Premise: Only government employees are eligible for the pension program. Pedro is eligible for the pension program. Conclusion: Pedro is a government employee.

Is this conclusion valid?
choices: The conclusion is valid only if Pedro applied.
The conclusion is valid only for regular employees.
questions.explanation: 'Only government employees are eligible' means eligibility is exclusive to government employees. If Pedro is eligible, he must be a government employee. This is valid reasoning.

questions.question: PARLIAMENT : LEGISLATURE :: CABINET : ___
questions.explanation: Parliament is a type of legislature (law-making body). The Cabinet is part of the executive branch (the branch that implements and enforces laws).

questions.question: What is the assumption in the statement: 'We should increase the salary of teachers to improve the quality of education.'?
choices: Higher salaries will attract better teachers and motivate existing ones.
questions.answer: Higher salaries will attract better teachers and motivate existing ones.
questions.explanation: The statement assumes a causal link between higher pay and better education quality. The underlying assumption is that salary is a key driver of teacher performance and recruitment.

questions.question: ARCHIPELAGO : ISLANDS :: CONSTELLATION : ___
questions.explanation: An archipelago is a group of islands. A constellation is a group of stars. The relationship is group : individual components.

questions.question: Some politicians are honest. All honest people are respected. Which conclusion is DEFINITELY true?
questions.explanation: Since some politicians are honest and all honest people are respected, those honest politicians must also be respected. Therefore, some politicians are respected.

questions.question: ORCHESTRA : CONDUCTOR :: ARMY : ___
questions.explanation: A conductor leads and directs an orchestra. A general leads and commands an army. The relationship is group : its leader.

questions.question:
A survey of 200 employees shows:
- 120 use public transportation
- 50 drive private cars
- 30 ride bicycles

What percentage uses public transportation?
MICROSCOPE : BACTERIA :: TELESCOPE : ___
questions.explanation: A microscope is used to observe bacteria (very small things). A telescope is used to observe stars (very distant things). The relationship is instrument : what it is used to observe.

questions.question:
Statement: 'If a student studies consistently, they will pass the board exam.'
Ana studied consistently.
Conclusion: Ana passed the board exam.

This reasoning is:
questions.explanation: This is modus ponens: If P then Q; P is true; therefore Q is true. If consistent studying (P) then passing (Q); Ana studied consistently (P); therefore Ana passed (Q). Logically valid.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Hammer, Screwdriver, Wrench, Calculator, Pliers
questions.explanation: All the others (Hammer, Screwdriver, Wrench, Pliers) are manual hand tools used for mechanical work. A Calculator is an electronic device used for computation — it does not belong to the same category.

questions.question:
Based on the data below, which month had the HIGHEST number of service requests?

Month | Requests
Jan   |   240
Feb   |   310
Mar   |   280
Apr   |   190
May   |   350
questions.explanation: Comparing all values: Jan=240, Feb=310, Mar=280, Apr=190, May=350. May has the highest number of requests at 350.

questions.question: EQUATION : MATHEMATICS :: STATUTE : ___
questions.explanation: An equation is a fundamental element/tool of mathematics. A statute (a written law) is a fundamental element of the legal system (law). The relationship is component : field it belongs to.

questions.question: No apples are oranges. Some fruits are apples. Therefore:
questions.explanation: Since some fruits are apples and no apples are oranges, those apple-fruits are definitely not oranges. Therefore, some fruits (at minimum, the apple-fruits) are not oranges.

questions.question: CARTOGRAPHY : MAPS :: LEXICOGRAPHY : ___
questions.explanation: Cartography is the science and practice of making maps. Lexicography is the science and practice of making dictionaries. The relationship is field of study : its primary product.

questions.question: The statement 'All that glitters is not gold' is an example of:
choices: A warning that appearances can be deceiving
questions.answer: A warning that appearances can be deceiving
questions.explanation: This proverb warns that just because something looks valuable or attractive does not mean it truly is. It is a caution against being misled by outward appearances.

questions.question: SUNLIGHT : SOLAR ENERGY :: WIND : ___
questions.explanation: Sunlight is the source of solar energy. Wind is the source of wind energy. The relationship is natural resource : the energy derived from it.

questions.question: A policy states: 'No government employee shall engage in private business.' Which situation VIOLATES this policy?
choices: A government nurse volunteering at a community clinic on weekends
A government teacher tutoring students for free
A government employee managing a family-owned restaurant
A government driver helping neighbors repair their cars as a hobby
questions.answer: A government employee managing a family-owned restaurant
questions.explanation: Managing a family-owned restaurant constitutes engaging in private business, which directly violates the stated policy. The other activities involve no private business operation.

questions.question: SEED : PLANT :: EGG : ___
questions.explanation: A seed develops into a plant. An egg develops into a bird. The relationship is initial form : fully developed organism.

questions.question:
Based on the table, what is the TREND in employee satisfaction scores?

Year | Score
2020 |  72
2021 |  68
2022 |  65
2023 |  61
questions.explanation: The scores consistently decrease each year: 72, 68, 65, 61. The differences are −4, −3, −4 — all negative, indicating a steady downward trend.

questions.question: ARCHIVIST : RECORDS :: CURATOR : ___
questions.explanation: An archivist manages and preserves records (documents). A curator manages and preserves artifacts (objects of historical or cultural significance, typically in a museum).

questions.question: Which conclusion is INVALID based on: 'Some civil servants are lazy. All lazy people waste resources.'?
choices: Some people who waste resources are civil servants.
Some lazy people are civil servants.
questions.explanation: The premises only tell us that SOME civil servants are lazy, not all. We can only conclude that some civil servants (the lazy ones) waste resources, not all of them.

questions.question: ETHICS : CONDUCT :: CONSTITUTION : ___
questions.explanation: Ethics guides conduct (personal behavior). The Constitution guides governance (how the government operates). The relationship is guiding document/principle : what it governs.

questions.question: A report shows: Department A processed 500 applications in 10 days; Department B processed 420 applications in 7 days. Which department is MORE efficient (applications per day)?
questions.explanation: Dept A rate = 500 ÷ 10 = 50/day. Dept B rate = 420 ÷ 7 = 60/day. Department B is more efficient at 60 applications per day.

questions.question: VACCINE : DISEASE :: EDUCATION : ___
questions.explanation: A vaccine prevents or fights disease. Education prevents or fights poverty (widely considered a key tool against poverty). The relationship is preventive measure : what it combats.

questions.question:
The government spends ₱50M annually on training programs. The data shows a 15% increase in employee productivity after training. A manager concludes that the training is worth the investment.

What ASSUMPTION does this conclusion rest on?
choices: The increased productivity results in benefits that outweigh the ₱50M cost.
Employee productivity is the only measure of success.
questions.answer: The increased productivity results in benefits that outweigh the ₱50M cost.
questions.explanation: For training to be 'worth the investment', the benefits (economic value of 15% productivity gain) must exceed the cost. The manager assumes this trade-off is positive — that the productivity gains justify the expenditure.
